text:
garrett: Heads-up  We're go for a soft launch + webinar in 12 days. Need a small visual bundle for the site and email: hero banner (1200x628), social square (1080x1080), slide hero (1920x1080), three microtiles (600x400), and a one-pager PDF template. Also require an inbound lead-routing diagram (SVG) and a sample CSV mapping for webhook teams. First comps by Fri COB. :calendar:

noor: Copy. Any preferred axis or data callouts? And share the benchmark CSV if you have it.

garrett: Use latency on x (ms) and cost on y ($/k tokens). Add a tiny inset sparkline (per-token cost over time). Data: https://files.redwood/launch/compact_bench.csv. Callouts: "smart routing (canary/fallback)", "batch/cache wins". Headline needs to be punchy: max 6 words for primary.

eve: Brand notes: Primary Blue #0A6AFF for latency, Accent Coral #FF6B61 for cost. Fonts: Inter for body, Inter-Bold for headings. Logo: provide dark & light variants, maintain 24px clearspace. AA contrast check required for microtiles.

pip: For routing diagram, are we including enterprise split? Also what form fields are we mapping?

garrett: Yes  enterprise -> sales-queue (immediate notify), else marketing nurture. Map these form fields:
```
form_field,webhook_key
utm_source,source
plan_choice,plan
interest_area,intent
```Include note to redact API keys in examples.

noor: Motion allowed? Small SVG draw for sparkline and a subtle parallax on hero only? File weight constraints?

eve: Subtle motion OK. Limit animations to <8s and keep hero <1MB when compressed. Provide static PNG fallbacks.

pip: CTAs? short lines pls.

garrett: CTA1: "Try Hosted API  Free Credits"; CTA2: "Book Dedicated Demo"; CTA3: "Download one-pager". We'll A/B hero headline length.

noor: Deliverables: 2 hero variants (A/B), slide hero, social, 3 microtiles, PDF one-pager (template + filled), routing SVG + CSV sample, alt text file. PNGs exported at 2x.

eve: Legal note: if third-party models are named, include attribution. Avoid absolute % claims without a citation. Send legal the comps for a quick review.

design-bot: Ticket created: DESIGN-7010 "Compact launch visuals + inbound routing"  assignee: noor, due: 1825075200.

noor: I'll create the Figma file and tag slices for dev export. Will upload compressed PNGs and a PDF by Fri COB. Pinging here when ready. :white_check_mark:

garrett: Thanks! If anything blocks, call me out in-thread or DM. :rocket:
